test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: Your employes also have acess to this data.
Your employes also have access to this data.
Your employees also have acces to this datas.
Your employees also have access to this data.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence with no spelling error is: *"Your employees also have access to this data."*
 
• The **explanation of the correct sentence** is as follows:
 
• "Your" is the correct spelling for the second person possessive adjective.
 
• "Employees" is the correct spelling for the plural form of "employee", which means someone who works for a person or business for wage or salary.
 
• "Also" is correctly spelled. It's an adverb that means 'in addition' or 'too'.
 
• "Have" is the correct form of the verb to have in this context.
 
• "Access" is correctly spelled and means the means or opportunity to approach or enter a place.
 
• "To" is a preposition, and it is correctly spelled.
 
• "This" is a demonstrative adjective that points forward to a following noun or noun phrase. It's correctly spelled.
 
• "Data" is the plural of "datum" and refers to facts and statistics collected together for reference or analysis. It is also correctly spelled.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: **"Your employees also have access to this data."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other sentences have spelling mistakes:
 
 
• **"Employes"** should be "employees" and** "acess"** should be "access".
 
• **"datas" **should be "data".
